Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Hi, fellow Methuselahs.

The 2012 Parisian Continental Qualifier will take place on Saturday August 25th in one of the most beautiful place of Paris, la Place des Vosges.

Date: Saturday August 25th, 2012
Registration: 10:00-10:30. First round starts at 10:40. Be on time!
Lunch time: 12:45-13:45
Second round: 14:00-16:00
Third round: 16:15-18:15
Final round: 18:30-20:30

3R+F

Fee: 7€ if you're not already part of our association, 5€ otherwise. Joining the association costs 2€ (+5€ for the tournament).

We'll have fresh drinks and chocolate bars.

Tournament place: Lycée Théophile Gautier, 6bis place des Vosges, 75004 PARIS, Métro Bastille/Chemin vert/Bréguet Sabin

maps.google.fr/maps?f=q&source=s_q&hl=fr&geocode=&q=6bis+place+des+Vosges,+75004+PARIS&aq=&sll=46.75984,1.738281&sspn=14.680315,33.815918&vpsrc=0&t=h&ie=UTF8&hq=&hnear=6+Place+des+Vosges,+75004+Paris,+%C3%8Ele-de-France&z=17&iwloc=A

We have room for many (40 at least), and can move the table to the courtyard if it's too hot

It's not far from the Gare de Lyon station (15 minutes, line 1 from Gare de Lyon to Bastille or Saint-Paul) and from Gare de l'Est (for German guys) (17 minutes, line 5 from Gare de l'Est to Bastille).

If you're taking the plane and landing to Roissy Charles de Gaulle (terminal 1 or 2), it takes 1 hour (RER B towards Gare du Nord, then line 5 to Bastille). Count 10 extra minutes if you're landing at terminal 3.

All the duration given suppose that you know your way, have tickets and catch the train right away, so take an extra security margin of 20 minutes.

If you have any question, feel free to ask here. Send me a PM if you want my phone number.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
